title: Death at the Old Cottage
intro_text: The Old Cottage in Willowbrook has been quiet for days. A note left on a side table hints at hidden secrets, and now it is believed someone within knows more than they are saying.

locations.name: Copper Kettle Cafe
locations.description: Cozy nooks where the steam from cups clatters softly against saucers, and the air is filled with the comforting aroma of strong tea.

locations.name: Quiet Residence
locations.description: A small, weathered cottage nestled on a peaceful lane, its windows casting gentle shadows through the trees.

locations.name: Elder Park
locations.description: A verdant haven where paths wind between ancient trees and benches provide spots for quiet contemplation under the canopy of leaves.

methods.text: Method 1: loosened a beam they knew was dangerous in the night.
Method 2: tricked them into a dangerous meeting place at the park.
Method 3: sent them down the wrong road at dusk.
Method 4: loosened their leg brace during a public display.

motives.text: Motive 1: end a feud that had been simmering for years.
Motive 2: keep a stolen land deed hidden.
Motive 3: punish them for a public humiliation.
Motive 4: stop an old letter from being read aloud.
